overview.description: The M.D. Sass Concentrated Value ETF (SASS) is an exchange-traded fund. The fund's investment portfolio concentrates primarily on total market equity. SASS is an actively managed fund that invests in a concentrated portfolio of US -listed large- and mid-cap value companies. SASS was launched on Mar 4, 2026 and is issued by M.D. Sass.
